title: Titan X Blue Raspberry Prefilled Pod +Refill
description: The Titan X Refill Kit in Blue Raspberry is designed for use with the Titan X Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. This convenient refill pack includes a 2ml prefilled mouthpiece pod and three 5ml flavour-matched auto-refill capsules, ensuring long-lasting, consistent flavour with no manual refilling required. Just click the pod and capsules into place on your Titan X device and you’re ready to go. The refill pack’s Blue Raspberry flavour delivers a bold, tangy burst of ripe berry flavour with a juicy, syrupy sweetness and a delightfully tangy finish. Each puff offers a satisfyingly rich mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape sensation, complemented by a smooth nicotine salt formulation for a comfortable mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape and rapid nicotine relief. Engineered for simplicity and reliability, the Titan X Refill Kit’s 2ml pod features a pre-installed mesh coil for enhanced flavour delivery and vapour production. Together with the Titan X device’s smart auto-refill technology, this kit can provide up to approximately 10,000 puffs per refill cycle (usage-dependent), offering excellent value and convenience for daily vaping.
